message: Hi, I'm a student with a shell programming certification background. My overall academic average is 75% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in data engineering and security. Honestly I'm not fully sure what I want to become — something in tech. My family can afford at most about USD 1100 per year. I live in Bengaluru. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: interested in data engineering and security

explanation:
This program is highly recommended because it directly aligns with your stated interest in security and offers a strong job outlook. With an impressive placement rate of 80% and a median starting salary of $8637, this degree maximizes your priority of securing good employment. The main trade-off here is the tuition cost ($1250), which exceeds your stated budget limit of $1100.

As a strong match for your interest in data engineering and analytics, this MSc Data Science program is an excellent career path choice. It provides relevant skills in 'data_science_analytics' and has a solid median starting salary of $6767. However, like the cybersecurity option, the annual tuition of $1200 exceeds your maximum affordable budget of $1100.

This MTech Computer Science program is a strong option because it respects your financial constraint with an annual tuition of only $500. Furthermore, its curriculum covers 'data_science_analytics' and 'software_engineering,' aligning well with your interests. The main trade-off to consider is that while affordable, the median starting salary ($6851) is lower compared to other available options.

If adhering strictly to your budget is paramount, this MSc Human-Computer Interaction program offers the best combination of affordability and job placement. With a tuition fee of $900, it remains within your financial limit while boasting a high placement rate of 77% and a strong median starting salary of $9186. The trade-off is that its focus on 'design_hci' does not directly match your stated interests in data or security.
